verses.text: But Noe found grace before the Lord.
verses.note: Noah finds grace before the Lord.

verses.text: These are the generations of Noe: Noe was a just and perfect man in his generations, he walked with God.
verses.note: Noah is a just and perfect man who walks with God.

verses.text: And God remembered Noe, and all the living creatures, and all the cattle which were with him in the ark, and brought a wind upon the earth, and the waters were abated.
verses.note: God remembers Noah and every living creature in the ark, and the waters are abated.

verses.text: And the ark rested in the seventh month, the seven and twentieth day of the month, upon the mountains of Armenia.
verses.note: The ark comes to rest upon the mountains of Armenia.

verses.text: And after that forty days were passed, Noe, opening the window of the ark which he had made, sent forth a raven:
verses.note: After forty days Noah opens the window of the ark and sends out a raven.

verses.text: Which went forth and did not return, till the waters were dried up upon the earth.
verses.note: The raven goes out and does not return until the waters are dried up.

verses.text: He sent forth also a dove after him, to see if the waters had now ceased upon the face of the earth.
verses.note: Noah sends out a dove to see whether the waters have ceased.

verses.text: But she, not finding where her foot might rest, returned to him into the ark: for the waters were upon the whole earth: and he put forth his hand, and caught her, and brought her into the ark.
verses.note: The dove finds nowhere to rest her foot, and returns to Noah in the ark.

verses.text: And having waited yet seven other days, he again sent forth the dove out of the ark.
verses.note: After seven more days Noah sends the dove out again.

verses.text: And she came to him in the evening, carrying a bough of an olive tree, with green leaves, in her mouth. Noe therefore understood that the waters were ceased upon the earth.
verses.note: The dove returns in the evening with an olive bough, and Noah understands that the waters have ceased.

verses.text: And he stayed yet other seven days: and he sent forth the dove, which returned not any more unto him.
verses.note: After seven more days he sends the dove, and she does not return.

verses.text: Therefore in the six hundredth and first year, the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were lessened upon the earth, and Noe opening the covering of the ark, looked, and saw that the face of the earth was dried.
verses.note: Noah opens the covering of the ark and sees that the earth is dry.

verses.text: And the Lord smelled a sweet savour, and said: I will no more curse the earth for the sake of man: for the imagination and thought of man's heart are prone to evil from his youth: therefore I will no more destroy every living soul as I have done.
verses.note: The Lord promises that he will no more curse the earth for the sake of man.

verses.text: All the days of the earth, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, night and day, shall not cease.
verses.note: The Lord promises that seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, night and day shall not cease.

verses.text: I will establish my covenant with you, and all flesh shall be no more destroyed with the waters of a flood, neither shall there be from henceforth a flood to waste the earth.
verses.note: God establishes his covenant: never again a flood to waste the earth.

verses.text: I will set my bow in the clouds, and it shall be the sign of a covenant between me, and between the earth.
verses.note: God sets his bow in the clouds as the sign of the covenant.

verses.text: And I will remember my covenant with you, and with every living soul that beareth flesh: and there shall no more be waters of a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.note: God promises to remember his covenant, and that no more waters of a flood shall destroy all flesh.

verses.text: And the bow shall be in the clouds, and I shall see it, and shall remember the everlasting covenant, that was made between God and every living soul of all flesh which is upon the earth.
verses.note: The bow in the clouds will remind God of the everlasting covenant.

verses.text: And Jesus being baptized, forthwith came out of the water: and lo, the heavens were opened to him: and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him.
verses.note: At Jesus' baptism the heavens are opened and the Spirit of God descends as a dove.

verses.text: Behold I send you as sheep in the midst of wolves. Be ye therefore wise as serpents and simple as doves.
verses.note: Jesus tells his disciples to be wise as serpents and simple as doves.

verses.text: And I said: Who will give me wings like a dove, and I will fly and be at rest?
verses.note: The psalmist longs for wings like a dove, to fly and be at rest.

verses.text: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape, as a dove upon him; and a voice came from heaven: Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.note: The Holy Ghost descends as a dove upon Jesus, and a voice comes from heaven.

verses.text: And John gave testimony, saying: I saw the Spirit coming down, as a dove from heaven, and he remained upon him.
verses.note: John testifies that he saw the Spirit coming down as a dove, and that he remained upon him.

verses.text: Which had been some time incredulous, when they waited for the patience of God in the days of Noe, when the ark was a building: wherein a few, that is, eight souls, were saved by water.
verses.note: Peter recalls the few, eight souls, who were saved by water in the days of Noah.
